text.p: The Turkish lira closed easier at 89,030 to the dollar on Thursday after Wednesday's 88,835 in line with the dollar's gains against the mark in world markets.
The central bank set its dollar rate for banks' compulsory monthly hard currency transfers at 88,900 lira, up from 88,600 at yesterday's close.

O/N money traded between 68.25 and 74.25 percent during the day and the central bank drained 2.2 trillion lira of idle cash at 50 percent at the close. The bank had lent 6.2 trillion lira to banks at 75 percent on Wednesday due to strong money demand.
In the t-bill market, yields dropped by 1-2 points across the board on rising liquidity.
The yield on the most active March 12, 1997 paper, sold at an average of 128.92 percent in Tuesday's Treasury auction, fell to 124.51 percent from Wednesday's 125.28 percent average.
The second most heavily traded February 26 paper yielded 123.73 percent after 125.11 yesterday.
